description: This file contains database migration scripts for the 'resample' feature in the Superset project, including upgrade and downgrade functions that modify the 'params' field of 'slices' based on resampling logic.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing the 'slices' table with 'id' and 'params' fields.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema/data migration to update 'resample' parameters in 'slices'.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts 'resample' parameter changes in 'slices' to previous state.
